Europe PMC.note: Systematic date-bounded metadata, abstracts, and open full text were available.

Nature / Communications Medicine.note: The cancer extraction article was accessible and cross-checked against Europe PMC full text.

Oxford Academic / JAMIA Open.note: Metadata and the abstract were available; full text required subscription access.

PubMed.note: Metadata was available, while some web routes presented a reCAPTCHA interstitial.

Wiley DOI.note: The anti-amyloid pharmacovigilance DOI was inconsistently indexed in search; PubMed supplied the stable record and abstract.

LinkedIn.note: Public indexing is incomplete and was used only for discovery.

medRxiv.note: Discovery metadata remained available; direct full-text routes have intermittently returned HTTP 403.

Black Swan Causal Labs.note: The public homepage was accessible; no clearly dated in-window item cleared the inclusion gate.

note: Source limitations do not imply that an inaccessible social account or page contained no new material.
